title: Exact finite verification of Brändén cut-sum polynomials for cyclic-crown order ideals

definitions.order_ideal_heights: 0 <= h_i <= k and h_i <= h_(i-1 mod n) + 1; column i contains layers 1 through h_i.
definitions.cut_sum: H_I^(m)(t) = sum_{L_o(w)<L_o(m)} H_(I\\{m})^(w)(t) + t sum_{L_o(w)>L_o(m)} H_(I\\{m})^(w)(t); H_empty=1.
definitions.canonical_origin: Rotate to the unique start of a proper cyclic arc on which the height is maximal; use origin 0 when the maximum set is the full circle or has multiple arcs.
definitions.branden_relation_convention: For ordered pair f,g, f preceq g is certified when abs(deg(f)-deg(g))<=1 and the coefficient Bezoutian (f(u)g(v)-g(u)f(v))/(u-v) is positive semidefinite.
definitions.root_proof_method: SymPy exact real-root isolation (Sturm intervals) counts all roots with multiplicity; exact positive-root count subtracts the zero-root multiplicity.
definitions.bezoutian_scope: The matrix is constant in the coefficient basis. Positive semidefiniteness is an exact pairwise interlacing certificate; it is not a pointwise matrix evaluation in t.
definitions.operator_minor_scope: All 2x2 minors are checked at N=2 for every cyclic-origin block. This necessary TP2 test is not a test of every higher-order minor or a proof for arbitrary n.

general_n_induction.reason: The exact computations cover only the five requested (k,n) instances. In addition, the global transition matrix has a negative 2x2 minor, so total nonnegativity of that operator cannot serve as a general preservation proof.

interlacing.canonical_order: Increasing normalized natural label L_o(m); o is the start of the unique proper cyclic arc of maximum column height, or 0 when there is no unique such arc.

bezoutian_and_stability.matrix_parameter_note: The coefficient Bezoutian is a constant symmetric matrix, not a matrix-valued function of t. Its positive-semidefinite certificate implies its diagonal quadratic form is nonnegative for every real t.

extremal_polynomial_tests.scope: For every ideal with at least two maxima, test the first/last polynomial in canonical order; single-maximum ideals are vacuous.

transition_operator.exact_operator_entry: M_N^(o)[(I,m),(J,w)] = 0 unless J=I\\{m} and w in max(J); otherwise 1 if L_o(w)<L_o(m), t if L_o(w)>L_o(m). For N=1 the empty-ideal predecessor has one base state with entry 1.
transition_operator.state_indexing: Rows are (I,m,o) with |I|=N and m maximal in I; columns are (J,w,o) with |J|=N-1 and w maximal in J. The full operator is the direct sum over cyclic origins o.

minor_test.scope: all 2x2 minors of every origin block at N=2
minor_test.interpretation: A negative 2x2 minor disproves total nonnegativity of this global matrix; this does not contradict the finite interlacing checks of the specific ideal-polynomial vectors.
